purpose: Machine-readable editorial proposal directory for locating, reviewing, and later applying approved original-name/place restorations. This file is diagnostic/planning metadata and is not authorization to rewrite Scripture.

languagePolicy.hebrewBible: Use Hebrew native-script forms by default; use Aramaic when the underlying biblical source passage itself is Aramaic.
languagePolicy.newTestamentGeneral: Preserve Greek and Aramaic/Peshitta witness forms where relevant. Later Greek-grounded writings may use Greek as the primary witness under the existing project source-priority policy.

yeshuaSpeech.rule: For metadata attached to words, names, or places occurring inside direct speech attributed to Yeshua, prefer an attested Aramaic/Peshitta native-script form when one is available. Preserve Greek/Hebrew witness forms as additional evidence rather than deleting them.
yeshuaSpeech.historicalCaution: The Syriac/Peshitta form is a textual witness used by this project policy; do not label it as certain verbatim first-century Galilean orthography or pronunciation.

languagePolicy.releaseRule: Every native form and proposed display form must be re-verified against the relevant source witness during the exact reference-level editorial review before any canonical replacement release.

scriptContract.scanCurrentForms: A diagnostic finder may scan currentForms as exact token/phrase candidates in the canonical EPUB.
scriptContract.neverAutoReplace: No script may automatically replace a hit solely because it matches currentForms.
scriptContract.requiredBeforeAfterLedger: For every intended change, generate reference, current verse text, proposed verse text, identity, native forms, scope decision, and exception status for human review.
scriptContract.bookTitleGuard: Book headings/titles are excluded unless a separate book-title decision is approved.
scriptContract.collisionGuard: Ambiguous strings, identities, compounds, demonyms, and ordinary-word collisions require reference-level classification.
scriptContract.yeshuaSpeechLanguageHook: If future verse metadata identifies speaker=Yeshua, set preferred original-language display/source metadata to the Aramaic/Peshitta native form when available.
